abort.reconfigure_successful: ✅ Account updated and data reloaded successfully!
abort.already_configured:
🔄 Customer code already configured!

✅ **Customer code `{title}` already exists in system**

🎯 **Your options:**
• **Edit settings**: Go to *Configuration* → *Reset billing start day*
• **Remove and recreate**: Delete old customer code before adding new one
• **Use different code**: Enter another customer code

💡 *Each customer code can only be configured once*

error.invalid_evn_code:
❌ Invalid customer code!

✅ Correct format:
• Must start with P or S
• Must have at least 11 characters
• Example: PE06800012345
error.customer_not_found:
🔍 Customer code not found!

❗ Possible reasons:
• Incorrect customer code entered
• EVN VN Addon error
• EVN VN Addon still fetching data

💬 Please check again or contact admin
error.invalid_format:
❌ Invalid customer code format!

✅ Correct format:
• Must start with P or S
• Must have at least 11 characters
• Example: PE06800012345
error.invalid_auth:
❌ Login failed!

❗ Please check:
• Username
• Password
• Network connection
error.wrong_region:
❌ Customer ID does not belong to the selected region!

🔁 Go back and pick the region matching the first 2 characters of the ID:
• **PD** → Ha Noi (HN)
• **PE** → Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC)
• **PA, PH, PM, PN** → North (NPC)
• **PC, PP, PQ** → Central (CPC)
• **PB, PK** → South (SPC)
error.no_data:
⚠️ Could not retrieve data!

❗ Possible reasons:
• Incorrect customer ID
• No data available in system
• API connection error
error.unknown:
❌ An unknown error occurred!

💬 Please try again or check logs for details
